cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In your festival thanks, name my stage repair. Please put it before you introduce the dancers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have ten seconds to thank the whole team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the job, not an adjective. 'Pat replaced the rotten boards' is shorter than 'our wonderful volunteers worked tirelessly'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can say you made the stage safe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Safe for whom? Add 'for tonight's dancers'. I replaced the boards under their landing spot, not the whole stage; please give me the right credit.
